articles.headline: Betting buzz: How improbable is this Browns season? Here's what the numbers say
articles.description: Only 10 games into the season, the Cleveland Browns have already hit the over on their preseason win total, and that's just one of many eye-opening numbers.

images.name: KC Concepcion [1296x729]
images.caption: The Browns moved to 6-4 on the season, coming from behind on Sunday after trailing 17-0 to the Texans.
images.alt: KC Concepcion #1 and Deshaun Watson #4 of the Cleveland Browns celebrate after a 6-yard rushing touchdown by Concepcion during the third quarter against the Houston Texans at Huntington Bank Field on November 15, 2026 in Cleveland, Ohio.

images.name: Michael Wilson [1296x729]
images.caption: The Cardinals picked up their third win of the season on Sunday, beating the Cowboys in improbable fashion.
images.alt: Arizona Cardinals wide receiver Michael Wilson, right, makes a touchdown catch as Dallas Cowboys safety P.J. Locke (1) looks on during an NFL football game in Arlington, Texas, Sunday, Nov. 1, 2026.

images.name: Tucker Kraft [1296x729]
images.caption: Tucker Kraft put up seven catches for 143 yards and two touchdowns last year on National Tight Ends Day.
images.alt: Tucker Kraft celebrates scoring a touchdown.

images.name: Chad Ryland [1296x729]
images.caption: Chad Ryland's last-second field goal dropped the one-time Super Bowl favorite Rams to 2-4 on the season.
images.alt: Chad Ryland #38 of the Arizona Cardinals celebrates after his game winning field goal in his team's 18-16 win against the Los Angeles Rams at SoFi Stadium on October 18, 2026 in Inglewood, California.

images.name: Jayden Daniels [1296x729]
images.caption: The Commanders are kicking themselves for the way Sunday's tie against the Giants ended.
images.alt: Jayden Daniels #5 of the Washington Commanders reacts after being sacked in the first quarter of the game against the New York Giants at Northwest Stadium on October 11, 2026 in Landover, Maryland.

images.name: Marcus Mariota [1296x729]
images.caption: Led by backup QB Marcus Mariota, the Commanders shocked the Seahawks on Sunday.
images.alt: Washington Commanders quarterback Marcus Mariota (8) scrambles to avoid a tackle during the first half of an NFL football game against Seattle Seahawks, Sunday, Sept. 27, 2026 in Landover, Md.
